result.summary: Found 1 critical issue: an untranslated localization key is displayed to the user instead of the actual section title.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated, human-readable title (e.g., 'Popular near you').
issues.suggestion: Ensure the localization string for the key 'home_feed.popular_title' is properly loaded and rendered, so the intended translated title appears instead of the key.
